_comment: ArbitAI continuous harness pool config for Arbitrum WETH/USDC across three DEXes. RPC is supplied via the RPC_URL environment variable (NEVER put a key in this file). The harness refuses to run while any address below is still a placeholder (starts with 0xPANCAKE / 0xUNISWAP / 0xSUSHI or is empty). Preflight each address with: node sim/live_two_dex_watcher.mjs --chain arbitrum --check --poolA <uni> --poolB <pancake> --poolC <sushi>

A.note: UNVERIFIED candidate the user supplied. Run --check against the live chain to confirm it is the real Uniswap V3 WETH/USDC pool before trusting results. Quoter is the Uniswap QuoterV2 (default).

B.note: PLACEHOLDER. You MUST replace both the pool and the quoter with the real PancakeSwap V3 WETH/USDC Arbitrum addresses (from dexscreener.com/arbitrum, search 'WETH USDC'). PancakeSwap V3 uses its OWN quoter, not the Uniswap one. The harness will refuse to run until this is filled in.

C.note: Pool is a known SushiSwap V3 WETH/USDC Arbitrum pool the user identified. SushiSwap V3 uses its OWN quoter; replace the quoter placeholder with Sushi's QuoterV2 on Arbitrum, or the pool will be mis-quoted through the Uniswap quoter with a WARNING.
